# MURAL - Maynooth University Research Archive Library

> > MURAL is Maynooth University's institutional repository preserving and providing open access to research outputs across social sciences, theology, mathematics, technology, and library sciences.

The archive contains working papers from research institutes like NIRSA (National Institute for Regional and Spatial Analysis), journal articles, and scholarly works by Maynooth University faculty including prominent researchers such as Seán Ó Riain. Content spans sociology of technology and work, theological studies, mathematical research, and interdisciplinary scholarship reflecting Ireland's academic contributions.

## Key Topics

- Maynooth University
- NIRSA (National Institute for Regional and Spatial Analysis)
- Irish software industry and technology sector
- Seán Ó Riain
- Sociology of work and high-tech communities
- Work-life balance and employment flexibility
- Theological studies and Irish Theological Quarterly
- Globalization and Irish culture
- Social movements and development
- Academic library development
- Creative Commons licensing
- Working papers and repository records
- Faculty of Social Sciences
- Faculty of Theology

## Sociology of Technology and Work

- [High-tech Communities: Better Work or Just More Work?](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/593): Seán Ó Riain's article on work-life balance in high-tech communities
- [Remaking the Service Class? Class Relations Among Software Developers in Ireland](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/224): NIRSA working paper on class relations in Ireland's tech sector
- [The Politics of Mobility in Technology-Driven Commodity Chains](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/343): Seán Ó Riain on Irish software industry and global production networks
- [Dominance and Change in the Global Computer Industry](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/489): Seán Ó Riain on state developmentalism in global computer industry

## Globalization, Culture and Social Movements

- [Globalization and Culture: Placing Ireland](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/476): Honor Fagan's analysis of Irish cultural identity amid globalization
- ['The Bourgeoisie, Historically, Has Played a Most Revolutionary Part'](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/458): Cox & Nilsen on social movements from above and hegemonic structures
- [Gender, Culture and Development: A South African Experience](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/467): Fagan, Munck & Nadasen on gender and democratization in South Africa
- [Miss Cherry Blossom Meets Mainstream America](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/522): Rebecca King O'Riain's feminist critique of Asian American beauty pageants

## Theology and Religious Studies

- [Catholicism and Protestantism](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/644): Martin Henry's theological article on Christian reformation traditions
- [Pascal's God](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/628): Theological analysis of Pascal's Christian apologetics and philosophy
- ['Living the Rosary'](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/541): Brendan Leahy on Pope John Paul II's Marian devotion and the Rosary

## Mathematics and Engineering

- [Base Station Performance Model](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/594): Walsh & Farrell's research on base station performance and OBSAI systems
- [Projective modules and involutions](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/246): John Murray's algebra research on projective modules and finite groups
- [Monte-Carlo Estimations of the Downside Risk of Derivative Portfolios](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/567): Patrick Leoni's working paper on Monte-Carlo risk assessment methods
- [Sums and Products of Indirect Utility Functions](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/79): Denis Conniffe's NIRSA paper on utility theory and demand systems

## Library and Information Sciences

- [The EU libraries programme- The Irish academic library context](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/657): Helen Fallon on Irish academic libraries in EU collaboration programs
- [Look Back and Wonder](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/647): Helen Fallon's VSO experience in Sierra Leone library development
- [ExPERT: An online database of University Examination Papers](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/73): Linda Noonan on ExPERT examination paper database system design

## Optional

- [The Opisthokonta and the Ecdysozoa May Not Be Clades](https://mural.maynoothuniversity.ie/id/eprint/673): Phylogenetic research challenging Opisthokonta and Ecdysozoa clade status
